summary.text: Customers love these Halloween pillow covers for their cute ghost pattern and soft textured design, with one noting it's a perfect mix of soft and spooky. The covers are versatile for decorating, particularly for the spooky season, and feature a sturdy zipper closure that's easy to remove the pillow form. They fit 20-inch throw pillows nicely, hold up well in the wash, and one customer mentions the color is thick enough that it doesn't show through.

authors_reviews.title: Adorably Spooky and Soft 👻👻👻
authors_reviews.text: These Halloween pillow covers exceeded my expectations! The material is incredibly soft and plush—perfect for adding a cozy, festive vibe to my living room. They’re not just decorative; they’re actually comfortable enough to lean on during movie nights.The designs are adorable and fun without being too over-the-top. I got a few different patterns (ghosts, pumpkins, bats), and they all look just as vibrant and detailed in person as they did online. They fit perfectly over my standard throw pillows, and the zippers are hidden and smooth.Such an easy way to add some Halloween spirit to the house without going full haunted mansion. I’ll definitely be pulling these out every October—and maybe even leaving them out a little longer!Highly recommend for anyone who loves Halloween decor that’s both cute and comfy.
authors_reviews.author: Paul Billman

They’re a simple little decoration, but they definitely make the room feel more festive for Halloween.
